sources.purpose: probe bank, not a finished craft bank: it exists to answer ONE question with evidence — does the video model hold flat 2D cel animation, or does it drift back to photoreal?
sources.plates: studio/motions/anime_plate.py — synthetic flat plates, 5-11 colours, so style retention is isolated from input detail
sources.rules_from: studio/motions/bank.json (One-Move Rule, one beat, end-state anchor, stated negative) applied unchanged to 2D

rules.style_is_a_block: In 2D the [look] block is not grading, it is the medium: flat cel, hard shadow, line art. Never mix a photoreal word into it.
rules.no_depth_of_field: Anime backgrounds are painted flat with a horizon band, not a bokeh field. Bokeh is a photoreal tell and invites the model back to 3D.
rules.blink_is_two_frames: A blink is the cheapest animation unit there is: two frames closed, hold, open. Ask for 'one blink' and nothing else.
rules.hold_the_line: Line width must be constant. Say 'constant line width, clean line art' or the model thickens lines as it moves.
rules.motion_is_limited: 2D animation is shot on twos and threes. Ask for slow, few, deliberate movements — never for realistic continuous motion.
rules.one_move: Only ONE camera move per shot (carried over from the live-action bank).
rules.end_state: Anchor the last frame, same as live action: 'by the last frame ...'.
rules.draft_pass_first: A model-rendered frame is stable as a key frame (4 s drift 5.4/255); a raw synthetic plate is not (49-76/255). Burn one draft clip, keep its last frame, chain every real shot from it.
rules.camera_in_post: The model repaints regardless of camera move — drift was the same for static and push-in. Do the push in ffmpeg on a held frame, not in the prompt.
rules.no_composite_input: Never feed the model a pasted collage. A sheet is one flat drawing, so give the sheet itself; a composed plate of layers makes the model spend the clip repairing edges (legs detached, 15.9 -> 25.6 drift).
rules.frame_with_words: New shot size is asked for in the prompt on top of the last frame ('now a medium close-up of the same man, his face filling the left half') — that worked; cropping and pasting in PIL did not.
rules.dutch_in_post: A tilted key frame comes back upright. Bake the Dutch angle in the edit, not in the image.
rules.wan_prompt_shape: Wan I2V wants motion, not description: under 100 words, no words for what is already in the input frame, no negative block (the endpoint has no field). Official contract: Wan-Video/Wan2.2 wan/utils/system_prompt.py

camera.en: locked-off static composition, the camera never moves, no zoom, no pan, no parallax
the camera pushes in only {cm} cm over the full {sec} seconds — slow enough to barely register, no zoom
slow dolly push from wide to medium over the full {sec} seconds, constant speed
a single steady pan right of {deg} degrees over the full {sec} seconds, no handheld

shot_size.en: insert shot, tight on a single detail

subject.en: the girl stands still under a clear umbrella, seen from behind, coat hanging straight, only the umbrella tilting {cm} cm and settling
the eye blinks once — lids close, hold for three frames, open — and then stays open, the pupil still
she walks away from camera, four steps, coat tail swaying once per step, then stops
one strand of hair lifts across the frame and settles back into place, nothing else in the frame moves
nothing in the frame moves except the rain
she stands without moving, coat and hair pulled hard to one side by the wind, the hem flapping once and settling
he stands without moving, the pauldron and the hair pulled to one side by the wind, weight on the back foot
the head turns a few degrees toward camera and stops, eyes finding the lens and staying
one blink — lids close over three frames and open again — then nothing
the blade lifts ten centimetres and stops, the arms not moving otherwise
the shoulders drop once, the chin lowers a few degrees, and stays

micro.en: the umbrella tilts back no more than {cm} cm and settles
one blink, lids closing over three frames and opening again
shoulders rise and fall once with a breath, no other movement

emotion.en: the shoulders drop a little, the head lowers a few degrees
her weight shifts from one foot to the other and back

environment.en: rain falling as thin straight strokes, constant speed, same direction
telephone wires perfectly still across the top of the frame
the windows of the far building glow steadily, no flicker

look.en: 2D cel animation, flat colour fields, hard-edged shadows, constant line width, clean line art, limited palette of deep blue and warm amber, anime background painting, no gradients except the sky band, no texture, no photographic detail, no depth of field, no 3D render

2D cel animation close-up, flat skin tone with one hard shadow shape, hair as solid black masses, iris as flat colour with one highlight, constant line width, no gradient, no texture, no depth of field, no 3D render

negative.default: no text, no subtitle, no watermark, no photorealism, no skin pores, no 3D render, no CGI, no depth of field, no bokeh, no motion blur, no camera shake, no zoom, no warping, no morphing, no frame reversal, no extra limbs, no melting lines
negative.static: no camera movement at all, no drift, no reframing, no parallax, no text, no subtitle
